profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Computer Vision & Retail Systems | Self-Checkout & Hardware Integration
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer with experience building and scaling computer vision systems for self‑checkout in real retail environments.

Over the past several years, I’ve worked on Picklist Assist: from early data collection and prototyping through production deployment and ongoing support at scale. My work has focused primarily on the client side, including integration with self‑checkout UIs, lane hardware, cameras, and cloud‑based classification systems.

I tend to work close to the problem: debugging real‑world issues, understanding hardware constraints, and helping teams translate field learnings into more reliable systems.

I value thoughtful engineering, collaboration across disciplines, and making complex technology work where it actually matters.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Core engineer on Picklist Assist, a computer‑vision product for self‑checkout. Own client-side integration between self‑checkout UI, camera hardware, scale sensors, and cloud‑based vision services. Lead hands‑on troubleshooting of production self‑checkout lanes, with focus on camera behavior, lighting, and real‑world edge cases.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: End-to-end web and mobile application development for small businesses. Project management, software architecture, software development, and testing for small business clients. Relationship management with customers to ensure project success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack software design and engineering for a variety of different products: digital asset management, inventory management, communication tools, games, apps, and scripting and automation for Adobe products. Getting to know a person's pain points so I can create applications and systems that improve their workflow and outcomes.

Lead software engineer for Archer, P.I., an AR game developed in tandem with season 8 of "Archer" on FX Networks. Managed a small team of developers on a very accelerated timeline to conceive, research, design, develop, and test the game for both Android and iOS platforms. Unity 3D development in C#.

Backend software in Python or TypeScript with frontend applications HTML5/CSS3/React. App data persisted with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and SQLite. Extensive systems administration experience writing shell scripts, daemons, and services for maintenance and deployment to desktops, intranet, and cloud services.

positions.title: Illustrator
positions.description:
Illustration work in a variety of different styles and finish, from pre-vis to final assets, depending on the needs of the show. Most of my layouts and visualization work is in Photoshop while final art assets are created in Illustrator.

Archer Seasons 3 & 4, FX Networks
Creation of final assets seen on the show, including major and minor characters, costumes, and props. Illustration of "key" poses and gestures that are later handed off to the After Effects team for animation. Minor prop design and scene layouts.

Slash 'Em (animated short), Mondo Media
Pre-visualization and "mood" drawings. Character rigging and scene setup.

Chozen, FX Networks
Character illustration and rigging. 

Undisclosed Animated Short, FX Networks
Scene layouts, character illustration, and minor prop design.

positions.title: Linguist / Translator
positions.description: Translation of legal documents from Spanish to English. Responsible for communicating with team members on the field and translating telephone conversations in real-time. Relationship analysis based on intercepted telephone conversations.

positions.title: Software Sales Account Executive
positions.description: Responsible for BIOS sales in the Midwest US territory. Designed promotional materials such as handouts, presentations, and giveaways for company conferences and trade-shows. Designed identities for new products and services. Redesigned the online customer documentation portal and enhanced documentation templates to improve customer experience.

positions.title: Scientific Illustrator and Graphic Designer
positions.description: Created various scientific illustrations of sea organisms and coastal areas. Designed layouts for book covers, posters, and other materials. Redesigned, implemented and maintained the program website.

positions.title: Validation/Test Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the validation of test software and documentation for the NASA GOES O/P satellites. Satellite hardware testing in the Integration and Test Complex (ITC).

positions.title: Validation/Test Engineer
positions.description: Writing Visual Basic tools for large databases in Excel. Developed and tested procedures used during satellite testing for the GOES N program. Logistics for implementation of LEAN manufacturing techniques in the ITC. Software validation.
